correctness.rationale: For 0<θ<1, R>s>0, T,P,ε>0, the sigmoid logit equation xdot=logistic(βg)−x and logistic resource n-dot=εn(1−n)((1+θ)x−1) have x*=1/(1+θ), n*(β)=(K−C/β)/D, K=R−θs,D=R+T+θ(P−s),C=(1+θ)log(1/θ). The Jacobian trace along this branch has strictly positive β slope q(1+θ)(RP+sT)/D, a negative entry trace at branch threshold and det>0; hence unique interior transversal Hopf β_h. At Hopf standard canonical linear X,Y coordinates make the first Lyapunov coefficient equal to H(ε)/16, with H=−(1+θ)(R+T+P−s)/(qD)+εβ_h n_h(1−n_h)[(1−3θ)(P−s)−(3−θ)(R+T)]. The proof computes explicit third derivatives and uses the full planar Hopf formula; environment cross derivatives G_xy matter only through g_xx=g_yy=0 in that coefficient. A fresh independent calculation differentiated the original nonlinear sigmoid/resource vector field symbolically with Sympy and substituted its canonical planar coefficient, matching H/16 to ~1e−14 for θ=.1/R=2/s=.5/T=.5/P=50 at ε=1 and30, and an θ=.8 example. The sign change at ε_c≈23.6071 is realized by admissible positive payoff matrices. Equality H=0 correctly excludes nondegenerate Hopf criticality and no Bautin conclusion is asserted.
